description: Start a background job that permanently deletes every product matching the filter. Use it instead of bulk_delete_products when more than 1000 products match. Returns the job at once; it runs in batches, so follow its progress with get_product_bulk_job. A model runs one job at a time: if one is already queued or running the start is refused - read it with get_product_bulk_job by modelId. As with bulk_delete_products, a product still referenced by an open order or a page block is skipped; the finished job reports skippedCount and the first skipped products with their reason.

filter.description: Products to delete; omit to delete every product of the model

priceMax.description: Major units - filters the stored price field directly

priceMin.description: Major units - filters the stored price field directly

modelId.description: The product model's id or slug (from list_models)

name: start_bulk_delete_products
title: Start bulk delete products
